t_advice_summary_textbox.text: each gnome has a group of gnomes that take you to a forest to harvest muchrooms. there wont always be mushrooms in the forest. there is a chance for you to earn extra points eitheir 1x or 5x points

vb_textbox.text: you will be prestented with two gnomes at the start of the game you must choose one. whatever gnome you choose will take you to a forest to harvest muchrooms. you wont always get muchrooms. the more muchrooms you harvest the more points you earn. you will only have 1.5seconds to choose a gnome and to harvest the mushrooms
